info.bio: Mary Margaret O'Hara is a Canadian singer-songwriter and actress, who has been hailed as one of the greatest cult heroines in rock music despite having released very few of her own recordings. She is the sister of comedic actress Catherine O'Hara. Her music ranges from gentle, countrified pop to avant-garde tone poems. Her recorded output has been extremely limited - in addition to her full length album "Miss America", she released a "Christmas" EP in 1992, and contributed new songs and a score to the film "Apartment Hunting" in 2001.

scenes.name: Cantautores de los ochenta
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Absorbida la new wave, el mundo de los cantautores no vuelve a ser el mismo: los referentes pasan a ser Dylan, Neil Young, Cohen, Tim Buckley y Joni Mitchell. Las mujeres recuperan su estatus de seres filosóficos: Phranc, Suzanne Vega, Tracy Chapman, Melissa Etheridge, Michelle Shocked, Barbara Manning, Lucinda y Victoria Williams, Indigo Girls y, en Canadá, Jane Siberry, Mary Margaret O'Hara y Sarah McLachlan. Excéntricos: Jandek, Daniel Johnston, David Thomas, Alejandro Escovedo; en California, Stan Ridgway, Chris Isaak y Smog. En Gran Bretaña, Billy Bragg, Robyn Hitchcock, Julian Cope y, la voz más importante de la década, Nick Cave, predicador del apocalipsis moral (From Her To Eternity, The Good Son). Sinéad O'Connor, Sting, Morrissey, Momus; el pop celta de Enya y Loreena McKennitt; al cambiar la década, Joe Henry, Daniel Lanois y Bob Mould.

podcast.title: Film Soundtrack and Acting (2001)
podcast.body: Beyond her primary music releases, O'Hara contributed to a Canadian film in 2001, providing the soundtrack for "Apartment Hunting" and also acting in the movie. "She also provided the soundtrack for a Canadian film called Apartment Hunting in 2001. She also acted in it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Aborted Debut Production with Andy Partridge
podcast.body: In the early 1980s, her debut record was scheduled to be produced by Andy Partridge of XTC, known for his quirky style. However, the collaboration ended abruptly on the first day in the studio, with Partridge being fired because the combination of their "quirk plus quirk" did not work. "Her debut record was scheduled to be produced by Andy Partridge of XTC, another super quirky guy. That quirk plus quirk did not work and he was fired on the first day in the studio."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Admiration from Renowned Artists
podcast.body: O'Hara garnered significant praise and admiration from many influential musicians; Morrissey requested her for vocalizations on his single "November Spawned a Demon," and Michael Stipe of R.E.M., Radiohead, Bruce Cockburn, Dave Matthews, and Nick Cave were all noted fans of her distinct music. "Moresy was such a fan that he asked her to do some vocalizations on his single November Spawn Demonstrer. Michael Steip couldn't get enough of her. Radiohead, Bruce Coburn, Dave Matthews, Nick Cave, they were all fans."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Family Connection to Catherine O'Hara
podcast.body: Mary Margaret O'Hara is the younger sister of the renowned actress Catherine O'Hara. "She is the younger sister of actress Catherine O'Hara."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Shift to Acting and Limited New Music
podcast.body: Over the past two decades, Mary Margaret O'Hara has increasingly focused on acting roles in theater, film, and musicals. She has also continued to contribute to songs by other artists, such as Bob Wiseman of Blue Rodeo, with only one new song released under her own name in 2014. "In fact, Mary Margaret O'Hara has focused on acting over the last couple of decades, theater, film, musicals and so on, as well as contributing to songs of other artists such as Bob Weissman of Blue Rodeo. There was one new song in 2014, but that's been it."
